dict.string: ALO captures and replaces this Mac's system-audio playback while broadcasting so every Mac hears the same synchronized stream.
ALO uses this Mac's microphone only while you use Talk or join an Open Line.
ALO records the display or window and system audio you choose only while you are broadcasting.
ALO finds and streams audio, shared screens, room messages, and current track artwork to Macs on your local network.
ALO shows a camera preview in the notch only when you enable and open the camera feature.
ALO uses contacts to show sender names and photos when you enable Messages notifications in the notch.
ALO reads the calendars you select to show upcoming events when you enable calendar features in the notch.

ALO checks accessory connection and battery status when you enable Bluetooth notifications in the notch.
